control.name: CONTROL — make the reverse reader hand back nothing (every bounded read goes blind)

mutations.name: reduce the determinacy stop to the time window alone (a breaker run older than one hour is truncated into a closed breaker — the fail-OPEN a horizon-based bounded read produces)
return the partial read instead of falling back (an answer that was never determined is handed to the meters as if it were)
skip a malformed line in the bounded read instead of declining (a corrupt ledger reads as clean, and the exit-6 refusal never fires)
treat an unparseable timestamp as absent instead of fail-closed (a row the meters cannot place silently stops being counted)
relax the segment-name match to a prefix (the corrupt sidecar and anything else beginning audit.jsonl. is swept in as ledger history)
make segmentPaths return only the live file (rotation becomes the full state RESET auditrecover.go exists to prevent — budgets back to full, the idempotency store emptied, once a day)
let an empty live file end the LastEntry search (on the first invocation of each new UTC day the guard's disarm-transition check goes blind)
let a malformed final line fall through to the line before it (the guard answers from a row that is not the newest)
restore the desktoken cache-reuse audit row (the ledger goes back to recording one row per no-op, 74% of its own volume)
mutations.old: ac.suppress = true // no network call, no mint, nothing changed — no audit row
mutations.new: ac.suppress = false // no network call, no mint, nothing changed — no audit row
